title: Malmgren tracked by Majestic guardians

tellings.quote: They not only CIA but you know all the majestic all these guardians they also themselves to protect the world.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, says he was watched not only by the CIA, the US spy agency, but also by what he calls "Majestic". He describes this as a group of "guardians" who see their job as protecting the world. He speaks of it as something that happened to him, in a 2026 episode, and if true it would mean a hidden group beyond the normal agencies keeps watch over people who know about UFO matters.
